evidence: Scoped checks defer on unresolved extern data relocations emitted from src/technology.cpp (?Technology@@3PAURulesTechnology@@A, ?ExpansionEnabled@@3HA, ?StringTemp@@3PADA, ?PlayersData@@3PAUPlayerData@@A) because the defining TUs are outside this task's compiled set. The data-binding channel is source-owned RECOVERY_OBJECT annotations beside the owning definitions: read_objects reads them project-wide and verify_task's referenced_object_units loop compiles the annotated owner read-only, then object_targets verifies the external definition and resolves the relocation. This expansion authorizes only the annotation lines already inserted beside the pre-existing verified // 0x... address comments in src/alpha.cpp, src/game.cpp and src/strings.cpp - no other change to those files.
